dumps.text: Observation: the younger generation can be more spoiled, in a specific sense. You have to go through real experience before you can really demand something. A child obviously needs its basic needs fulfilled to survive, that part isn't questionable. The issue is young people growing up without separating their emotions, the anger at a parent or authority figure, from their actual needs. That can grow into something obnoxious: thinking you can demand things without having the basics in place first, like mathematics, physics, real competence.

Leute in der Gesellschaft complaining about the rich. The rich need to be taxed, but actually, is it the rich, or are the people in democratic or government positions? If you compare the two sides in terms of who is corrupt and who has the worst results for society, in my opinion, it's usually the corrupt bureaucracy and democracy. They are pointing to the rich and not admitting their own flaws, especially if you're a person who does a good job. If you come into a position in that kind of environment, and we have a lot of evidence (we can look that up), then you are corrupt in the first place because you earned the position in some ways. If you have the qualifications, good, but it turns out a lot of the people don't have the qualifications. They're overwhelmed, and then what they do also is they bribe, they corrupt, etc.

I see a lot of people posting things like "I don't want flying cars, I want some basic things" as hate and backlash against Elon Musk. I hate how simple that take is. They don't account for what's actually behind those companies: shareholders, long R&D cycles, the mechanics of tech evolution. Tech evolution in any field has always been one of the biggest things that improved the lives of millions of people across generations.
